description: LabelsLive owns deletion orchestration but duplicates single/bulk state. Use one socket-owned pending deletion with kind and previews; reuse existing LabelEvents -> NodeRouter -> validated single/bulk Actions and preserve all payloads/errors/messages/DOM IDs. No new Action or backend change. Simplify private label_choice always-selected argument without changing markup. Existing deletion LiveView/component tests verify success/cancel/stale/usage/permissions; no expectation changes. Socket lifetime unchanged; no new callbacks or processes. Non-goals: schemas, automation, query APIs, stale test correction. Roll back if defaults or event boundaries change or assertions need weakening. Update module documentation if necessary; mix q, isolated tests and final precommit.
title: [zaq-kw0.39] Unify label deletion UI state and simplify active choice
